title: RS-FMD model record (MLM field names)
description: One remote sensing foundation model (RSFM) or embedding product in RS-FMD, using STAC MLM (https://github.com/stac-extensions/mlm, v1.6.0) field names, or STAC core/extension names that MLM recommends, wherever one exists; fields with no MLM equivalent use plain names. Pretraining is described as a single phase. This is a flat record, not a complete STAC Item: it has no geometry/bbox, links, or stac_extensions, and it omits fields MLM requires but RS-FMD does not record (mlm:tasks, mlm:output). Unknown values are null; a field that is present but null means 'not stated in the source'. Use [] only for a list known to be empty (e.g. no image bands for a model whose only input is coordinates), and never write 'N/A' or 'not stated' strings into a field. Fields described as free text hold natural-language summaries rather than controlled values.

id.description: Unique, stable identifier for the record: lowercase slug of the model name, hyphens only, e.g. 'galileo', 'prithvi-eo-2-0'. Append a disambiguator such as the venue/year only when the slug is already taken by a different model (e.g. 'galileo-icml2025'). Primary key; the record's filename is '<id>.json'.

mlm:name.description: The model's name, without descriptive suffixes. Use the family name (e.g. 'Galileo'), not one size variant; describe variants in 'mlm:architecture'.

version.description: Version identifier of the model as named by its authors (e.g. 'v1', '2.0').

release_date.description: Date the model was first publicly released, as an RFC 3339 timestamp (e.g. '2025-07-13T00:00:00Z').

updated.description: When this model metadata was last updated, as an RFC 3339 timestamp.

description.description: A few sentences summarising what the model is, what data it takes, how it was trained, and what it is good at. For an embedding product (precomputed embeddings released as data), include 'precomputed embeddings'

sci:doi.description: DOI of the associated publication, without the 'https://doi.org/' prefix. Every arXiv paper has one: arXiv 2511.17442 -> '10.48550/arXiv.2511.17442'.

assets.description: Links to files and resources for the model, keyed by asset name. Use 'mlm:source_code' for the code repository. Add other entries as needed, e.g. Hugging Face weights with roles ['mlm:model', 'mlm:weights'], a precomputed embedding product or dataset under its own key with roles ['data'], or a container image with roles ['runtime'].

mlm:architecture.description: Backbone architecture, leading with a generic name (e.g. 'Vision Transformer', 'Swin Transformer', 'ResNet') followed by specific variants, e.g. 'Vision Transformer (ViT-B, ViT-L)'. Free text.

mlm:total_parameters.description: Total number of model parameters as a raw count (85M -> 85000000; 2B -> 2000000000). Use the primary/largest released variant. Count only the encoder that produces embeddings at inference time. For an embedding product, count the variant that produced the product.

pretext_training_type.description: Self-supervised or supervised pretraining paradigm, e.g. 'Masked autoencoder', 'Contrastive (SimCLR-style)', 'Image-text contrastive (CLIP-style)', 'Masked latent prediction'. Free text.

masking_strategy.description: How inputs are masked during pretraining (random, block, temporal, spectral, consistent across time, etc.). Record the ratio in mlm:hyperparameters.mask_ratio. Null for non-masking methods. Free text.

pretraining.description: Description of the pretraining approach: objectives, targets, losses, and notable training mechanics. Free text.

domain_knowledge.description: Remote-sensing-specific knowledge built into the model or its training, e.g. wavelength-aware band embeddings, month/season encodings, geolocation inputs, sensor-specific normalisation, geographic sampling.

backbone_modifications.description: Architectural changes relative to the standard backbone, e.g. per-sensor patch embeddings, variable patch size, temporal attention, channel-group tokenisation.

supported_sensors.description: Sensors or data products the model accepts as input when computing embeddings, by platform or product name (e.g. 'Sentinel-2', 'Landsat-8', 'NAIP', 'SRTM', 'ERA5'). Include ancillary products if the model ingests them. Data used only as a pretraining target or for supervision (e.g. GEDI or ERA5 reconstructed by the model, or the imagery used to train a location encoder whose input is coordinates) is not an input: describe it in 'pretraining'.

modality_integration_type.description: How input modalities are combined. Unimodal: one data type (e.g. RGB only). Homogeneous Multimodal: several sources of the same physical kind of imagery (e.g. multispectral from Sentinel-2 and Landsat, or optical + temporal stacks). Heterogeneous Multimodal: physically different remote sensing data (e.g. optical + SAR + elevation + weather). Cross-domain Multimodal: remote sensing paired with a non-image domain such as text or ground-level photos (vision-language and geolocation models).

modalities.description: Input data modalities supported when computing embeddings, e.g. 'Multispectral', 'Hyperspectral', 'SAR', 'RGB', 'LiDAR', 'Thermal Infrared', 'Elevation', 'Weather', 'Text', 'Time series'. Modalities used only as pretraining targets or in a training loss are not inputs.

spectral_alignment.description: Whether the model explicitly represents spectral relationships between bands. full: band identity or wavelength is encoded per band and arbitrary band sets are handled (e.g. wavelength-conditioned embeddings). partial: some spectral structure is modelled (e.g. fixed band groups with group embeddings) but the band set is fixed. none: bands are treated as plain input channels.

temporal_alignment.description: Whether the model explicitly represents multi-temporal sequences. full: native variable-length time series with temporal or date encodings. partial: a fixed small number of timesteps, or time handled only via simple stacking or pooling. none: single-date inputs only.

spatial_resolution.description: Ground sample distance of the input data, e.g. '10m', '0.3-1m', 'variable'. Free text.

temporal_resolution.description: Temporal sampling of the input data, e.g. 'monthly', '5-day revisit', 'single date', 'variable'. Free text.

mlm:input.description: One entry per model input, typically one per sensor or modality (e.g. 'Sentinel-2', 'Sentinel-1'), giving the bands used and the input tensor shape. Never combine several sensors into one entry. Non-image inputs (coordinates, categorical land-cover layers, captions) get their own entry. List only inputs used when computing embeddings, not pretraining-only targets.

mlm:pretrained_source.description: Name of the pretraining dataset(s). Free text.

regions_coverage.description: Geographic coverage of the pretraining data, e.g. 'Global', 'Europe', 'CONUS'.

start_datetime.description: Start of the acquisition period of the pretraining data, as an RFC 3339 timestamp (e.g. '2017-01-01T00:00:00Z'). If the source gives only an approximate period ('about one year around 2021', 'mostly 2019-2023'), leave start and end null and keep the wording in 'mlm:pretrained_source'. If the period is open-ended ('2017 to present'), set only the start.

end_datetime.description: End of the acquisition period of the pretraining data, as an RFC 3339 timestamp (e.g. '2023-12-31T23:59:59Z'). Null for approximate or open-ended periods (see 'start_datetime').

num_images.description: Number of pretraining samples (images, image time series, or pixel time series), before augmentation.

sampling.description: How pretraining locations or images were selected, e.g. stratified by land cover, random global. Free text.

processing:level.description: Product processing level of the pretraining imagery, e.g. 'L1C', 'L2A', 'GRD'.

processing:lineage.description: Preprocessing applied to the pretraining data (resampling, normalisation, compositing, reprojection, etc.). Free text.

cloud_cover.description: Cloud filtering applied to the pretraining data, e.g. '<10% cloud cover', 'cloud-masked composites'. Free text.

missing_data.description: How missing timesteps, bands, or pixels are handled. Free text.

mlm:hyperparameters.description: Pretraining hyperparameters. The properties below are the ones RS-FMD records; other keys are allowed, as in MLM.

patch_size.description: Patch or token size fed to the model, e.g. '16x16', 'variable 1-8 px'. Free text.

learning_rate.description: Learning rate and schedule, as a string because schedules and sweeps are common, e.g. '1e-4, cosine decay, 30-epoch warmup'.

mask_ratio.description: Fraction of tokens masked during pretraining, as a fraction in 0-1 (75% -> 0.75).

benchmarks.description: Downstream evaluations reported for this model, typically by its own authors. One entry per (dataset, task) pair.

Asset.$comment: Subset of the STAC Asset Object, with the MLM asset fields RS-FMD is likely to use.

type.description: Media type of the resource, e.g. 'text/html' for a repository page.

roles.description: Asset roles, e.g. ['mlm:source_code', 'code'] for a repository or ['mlm:model', 'mlm:weights'] for released weights.

mlm:artifact_type.description: Kind of model artifact, typically tied to a framework, e.g. 'torch.save', 'safetensors'. MLM requires it on assets with the 'mlm:model' role.

mlm:entrypoint.description: Entrypoint in the source code for running inference, e.g. 'package.module:function'.

ModelInput.$comment: MLM Model Input Object. MLM also requires `input`; it is optional here because papers often omit the full shape. MLM's value_scaling, resize_type and pre_processing_function are allowed but not described.

name.description: Name of the input, usually the sensor or product, e.g. 'Sentinel-2', 'Sentinel-1'.

description.description: Anything about this input not covered by the other fields.

bands.description: Bands or channels used from this input, e.g. ['B2', 'B3', 'B4', 'B8'] or ['VV', 'VH'].

input.description: Shape of the input tensor used in pretraining, e.g. shape [-1, 12, 96, 96] with dim_order ['batch', 'bands', 'height', 'width'] for 96x96 tiles of 12 bands.

shape.description: Size of each dimension; -1 means variable (commonly batch, time, or variable tile size).

dim_order.description: Name of each dimension in shape, using MLM's common names: 'batch', 'time', 'bands', 'channel', 'height', 'width', 'token', 'embedding'.

data_type.description: Data type of the processed tensor given to the model, e.g. 'float32'. MLM requires this; it is optional here.

Benchmark.$comment: MLM: no matching object. MLM has no fields for evaluation results or metrics. A benchmark only fits MLM if its fine-tuned model is published as its own Item (`mlm:tasks`, `mlm:output`, `mlm:hyperparameters`), so the mappings below assume that.

task.$comment: MLM: `mlm:tasks` (Item level) and `mlm:output[].tasks` (per head). MLM uses lowercase hyphenated names from its Task Enum, e.g. 'scene-classification', 'semantic-segmentation', 'object-detection', 'regression', 'similarity-search'.
task.description: Generic ML task type, e.g. 'Classification', 'Multilabel classification', 'Semantic segmentation', 'Change detection', 'Object detection', 'Regression', 'Retrieval', 'VQA'. Called 'application_type' in the paper's Table 6; the code and data use 'task'.

application.description: Specific real-world application, e.g. 'Crop type mapping', 'Flood mapping', 'Land cover classification'. Free text.

dataset.$comment: MLM: no MLM field. MLM best practices suggest a `derived_from` link to the dataset's STAC Collection (ML-AOI / Label extensions).
dataset.description: Benchmark dataset name, including the benchmark suite if relevant, e.g. 'm-EuroSat (GEO-Bench)', 'PASTIS'. Free text.

metrics.description: Metric names, parallel to metrics_value (same length and order). Each name should state the evaluation protocol and training-data fraction when the paper reports several, e.g. 'mIoU (linear probe, 100% train)', 'Top-1 Acc (kNN, 1% train)', 'F1 (finetune)'. Name the model variant when the paper reports more than one (e.g. 'mIoU (frozen encoder, 100% train), ViT-L'), and mark metrics where lower is better (e.g. 'RMSE (lower is better)').

metrics_value.description: Numeric score for each entry in metrics, same length and order, in the units the paper reports (usually percent). Use null for a metric the paper names but does not report. Take values from tables or text only: skip numbers that appear only in charts, and ablation rows that are not the final model.

sensor.$comment: MLM: no MLM field. Use STAC common metadata `constellation` / `platform` / `instruments` on the fine-tuned model's Item.
sensor.description: Sensors or data products used as input for this benchmark.

regions.$comment: MLM: STAC Item `geometry` / `bbox` of the fine-tuned model's Item.
regions.description: Geographic regions covered by the benchmark dataset, as stated in the paper or the dataset's own documentation (not from memory of the dataset).

image_resolution.description: Input tile size used in evaluation, e.g. '64x64', '128x128 subtiled to 64x64', as stated in the paper or the dataset's own documentation. Free text.

spatial_resolution.$comment: MLM: STAC common metadata `gsd` (a number in metres).
spatial_resolution.description: Ground sample distance of the benchmark data, e.g. '10m', as stated in the paper or the dataset's own documentation. Free text.

split_ratio.description: Train/validation/test split as stated in the source, as ratios or counts, e.g. '70/10/20' or 'train 2000 / test 1000'. Do not fill in parts the source does not give. Free text.
